title: gonostemon praetermissus
intro: Gonostemon praetermissus, commonly known as the "River Vine", is a plant species belonging to the family Asclepiadaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Gonostemon praetermissus include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of the River Vine plant have been found to include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
